samples.question: The grey line in this picture is one single cable. It never branches and it never touches or crosses itself, so it has exactly two loose ends. One of those ends lies inside the orange ring. The short black bar is a wall. The cable is drawn on top of the wall, so wherever the cable runs over the bar the bar is interrupted, and each such place counts as one crossing of the wall. Three dots - one red, one green and one blue - sit on the cable. Start at the end inside the orange ring and walk along the cable, following every bend, towards the other end. Ignore every dot you meet before your first crossing of the wall. Which dot is the first one you meet after you have crossed the wall for the first time? Answer red, green or blue.
